sentence: وَدِّيت السَّيَّارَة عَلَى service الْحِين
raw: وديت السيارة على service الحين
ipa: wadˈdiːt assajˈjaːra ˈʕalaː sarfis alˈħiːn
gloss_en: I took the car to service now
notes: [automotive] service→sarfis (/v/→[f], Alhoody 2019 §5.1). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: هَذَا model جَدِيد مَرَّة وْ automatic
raw: هذا model جديد مرة و automatic
ipa: ˈhaðaː mudil dʒaˈdiːd ˈmarra w aatumatik
gloss_en: this model is really new and automatic
notes: [automotive] model→mudil; automatic→aatumatik (/p/-free; English vowels collapse to the three Arabic qualities). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: عِنْدِي مِشْكِلَة فِي clutch وْ أَبِي gear جَدِيد
raw: عندي مشكلة في clutch و أبي gear جديد
ipa: ˈʕindiː ˈmiʃtsila ˈfiː klaʃ w ˈʔabiː dʒiːr dʒaˈdiːd
gloss_en: I have a problem with the clutch and I want a new gear
notes: [automotive] clutch→klaʃ (/tʃ/→[ʃ], Alhoody 2019 §5.1); gear→dʒiːr (native ǧīm /dʒ/ kept, not the Cairene stop [ɡ]); frame word مِشْكِلَة→[miʃtsila] shows Najdi velar affrication /k/→[ts] before a front vowel (Ingham 1994). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: عِنْدِي meeting مُهِمّ مَعَ الْمُدِير الْحِين
raw: عندي meeting مهم مع المدير الحين
ipa: ˈʕindiː miːtinɡ muˈhimm ˈmaʕa lmuˈdiːr alˈħiːn
gloss_en: I have an important meeting with the manager now
notes: [tech] meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ] elsewhere, Alhoody 2019 §5.1.10; the [ɡ] is the Najdi qāf reflex, so it is in inventory). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: نَزَّلْت file بَسّ مَا خَلَّص download
raw: نزلت file بس ما خلص download
ipa: nazˈzalt fil ˈbass ˈmaː ˈxallɑsˤ dawnloud
gloss_en: I downloaded a file but the download did not finish
notes: [tech] file→fil; download→dawnloud (/aʊ/→[aw]). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: أَبِي laptop جَدِيد بَسّ wifi بَطِيء
raw: أبي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʔabiː labtub dʒaˈdiːd ˈbass wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I want a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] laptop→labtub (/p/→[b], Alhoody 2019 §5.1); wifi→wifi. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: فِي offer زَيْن وْ discount كْبِير
raw: في offer زين و discount كبير
ipa: ˈfiː ufar ˈzajn w disawnt ˈkbiːr
gloss_en: there is a good offer and a big discount
notes: [commerce] offer→ufar; discount→disawnt (/aʊ/→[aw]). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: دَفَعْت cash مُو بِكَرْت
raw: دفعت cash مو بكرت
ipa: ˈdafaʕat kaʃ ˈmuː biˈtsart
gloss_en: I paid cash not by card
notes: [commerce] cash→kaʃ; frame word بِكَرْت→[bitsart] shows velar affrication /k/→[ts] before front /i/ (Ingham 1994; Al Mahmoud 2020). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: شُفْت الْمُدِير جَنْب garage
raw: شفت المدير جنب garage
ipa: ˈʃuft almuˈdiːr ˈdʒanb ɡaːradʒ
gloss_en: I saw the manager next to the garage
notes: [automotive] garage→ɡaːradʒ (final /ʒ/→[dʒ], Alhoody 2019 §5.1; Najdi has no /ʒ/). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: charger خَربَان وْ battery فَاضِي
raw: charger خربان و battery فاضي
ipa: ʃaːrdʒar xarˈbaːn w batari ˈfɑːðˤiː
gloss_en: the charger is broken and the battery is empty
notes: [tech] charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ]); battery→batari. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: مُو عَارِف بَسّ أَنَا think هَذَا غَالِي
raw: مو عارف بس أنا think هذا غالي
ipa: ˈmuː ˈʕaːrif ˈbass ˈʔanaː θink ˈhaðaː ˈɣaːliː
gloss_en: I don't know but I think this is expensive
notes: [daily] think→θink (interdental /θ/ RETAINED — Najdi keeps it where Cairene merges to [t]; Alhoody 2019 §5.1). table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: engine فِيه صَوت وْ brake ضَعِيف
raw: engine فيه صوت و brake ضعيف
ipa: inɡin ˈfiːh ˈsˤɑwt w brak ðˤɑˈʕiːf
gloss_en: the engine has a noise and the brake is weak
notes: [automotive] engine→inɡin (/ndʒ/→[nɡ]); brake→brak. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019 §5.1)

sentence: السَّيَّارَة فِيهَا بَنْشَر وْ لَازِم وَرْشَة
raw: السيارة فيها بنشر و لازم ورشة
ipa: assajˈjaːra ˈfiːhaː ˈbanʃar w ˈlaːzim ˈwarʃa
gloss_en: the car has a flat tyre and needs a workshop
notes: [automotive] بَنْشَر [banʃar] 'flat/puncture' < Eng. puncture — attested Gulf/Najdi car-register loan; وَرْشَة [warʃa] 'workshop' integrated loan. The pipeline reads both as native Arabic and matches the attested realisation. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019); Holes 2004 Gulf loan lexicon

sentence: الْجِير خَربَان لَازِم وَرْشَة
raw: الجير خربان لازم ورشة
ipa: alˈdʒiːr xarˈbaːn ˈlaːzim ˈwarʃa
gloss_en: the gear is broken, it needs a workshop
notes: [automotive] جِير [dʒiːr] 'gear' < Eng. gear — native ǧīm /dʒ/, attested Najdi car-register; pipeline matches. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019); Holes 2004

sentence: دَفَعْت كَاش مُو بِالْبِطَاقَة
raw: دفعت كاش مو بالبطاقة
ipa: ˈdafaʕat ˈkaːʃ ˈmuː bilbiˈtˤɑːɡa
gloss_en: I paid cash not by card
notes: [commerce] كَاش [kaːʃ] 'cash' < Eng. cash — attested loan; pipeline matches. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)

sentence: اِشْتَرَيت تِلِفِزْيُون جَدِيد لِلْبَيت
raw: اشتريت تلفزيون جديد للبيت
ipa: iʃtaˈrajt tilifizˈjuːn dʒaˈdiːd lilˈbajt
gloss_en: I bought a new television for the house
notes: [daily] تِلِفِزْيُون [tilifizjuːn] 'television' — long-established loan; the pipeline reads the vocalised spelling faithfully and matches the attested realisation. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019); Watson 2002

sentence: هَذَا مُودِيل السَّنَة الْجَدِيدَة
raw: هذا موديل السنة الجديدة
ipa: ˈhaðaː muːˈdiːl ˈassana aldʒaˈdiːda
gloss_en: this is this year's new model
notes: [automotive] مُودِيل [muːdiːl] 'model' < Eng. model — attested Najdi car-register loan. The loan's heavy final syllable takes the primary stress [muːˈdiːl]; the pipeline now places it there (the stress mark no longer lands inside the long vowel), so this row pins live engine output. table: Najdi (Alhoody 2019)
